newsitem.title: USA: America Online offers Banyan's Switchboard.
newsitem.headline: America Online offers Banyan's Switchboard.

text.p: Internet service company America Online Inc (AOL) on Monday said that it will integrate into its system Banyan Systems Inc's Switchboard Internet directory.
Switchboard is a directory, found on the Internet, that includes Internet e-mail and World Wide Web page addresses along side conventional name, telephone number and physical address data.
AOL will place a co-branded version of Switchboard with a custom AOL interface into its service, AOL said.
AOL said it will promote the service, and will also have an exclusive right for two years to sell all banner advertisements on the Switchboard service on commission.
The significant addition of advertising revenues from Switchboard will help AOL develop alternative revenue streams and further diversify its business model, the company said.
